# Lesevorlage [Reading Template]

```text
Use this template for articles, notes, and exercises.

Click Show Raw to view the Markdown source. Copy it to an AI assistant to reformat your notes.

Rules:
- Write target-language content normally.
- Put translations in square brackets: [English translation].
- Use headings for sections.
- Use lists and tables when they make notes easier to scan.
- Fenced text blocks like this one are visible but not read aloud.
```

## Kurze Absätze [Short Paragraphs]

Ich heiße Anna. [My name is Anna.]
Ich komme aus Deutschland. [I come from Germany.]
Ich lerne Deutsch. [I am learning German.]

## Kompakte Sätze [Compact Sentences]

Montag ist der erste Tag. [Monday is the first day.]; Dienstag kommt danach. [Tuesday comes after that.]

## Liste [List]

- Ich wohne in Bonn. [I live in Bonn.]
- Ich arbeite in Köln. [I work in Cologne.]
- Ich lerne Deutsch am Abend. [I study German in the evening.]

## Tabelle [Table]

| Deutsch | English |
|---|---|
| Guten Morgen. | [Good morning.] |
| Wie geht es dir? | [How are you?] |
